recognize_zh: 脾臟 H&E 高倍下，右上方為成片的小到中型淋巴球，核圓或略不規則，部分有少量淡色細胞質；左下方紅血球間的紅髓脾索與竇內也被同樣的淋巴球浸潤，符合脾邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: Dense infiltrate of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Some cells with a modest rim of pale cytoplasm (marginal zone-like)
Sheet-like nodular area (upper right) merging with red pulp infiltration among erythrocytes (lower left)
No large-cell sheets, starry-sky pattern, or prominent mitoses in this field
describe_en: Section of spleen shows a dense, monotonous infiltrate of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells forming a sheet in the white pulp region and extending into the adjacent red pulp, where the cells percolate between congested erythrocytes in cords and sinusoids. The cells have round to slightly irregular nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and a modest rim of pale cytoplasm. Large transformed cells are not increased in this field. Findings are consistent with involvement by a low-grade B-cell lymphoma, compatible with splenic marginal zone lymphoma in conjunction with the CD20-positive, CD43-negative immunophenotype.

ddx.vs: MCL cells have more irregular, cleaved nuclei with scant cytoplasm and are cyclin D1/SOX11 positive, which requires immunostaining to exclude.
CLL/SLL shows smaller round cells with scant cytoplasm, proliferation centers with prolymphocytes, and CD5/CD23/LEF1 co-expression.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL diffusely fills red pulp with atrophic rather than expanded white pulp and has villous cells with more basophilic cytoplasm.
LPL shows plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with Dutcher bodies and MYD88 L265P in most cases.
